# UI AUDIT — the reference UI as its SOURCE describes it

**GENERATED by `plugin/build/audit_ui.py`. Do not hand-edit.**

Every page built from a *rendered picture* of the reference came out wrong in a way that cost
a game restart. The Vue source states its layout exactly — `#navball { left: 14.59%; bottom:
8% }` — so read that, not a screenshot. Grep this file before designing any page.
